SELECT d.* FROM public.nocode_report_dashboard d JOIN public.nocode_report_dashboard_version v ON v.dashboard_id=d.id AND v.version_no=d.published_version AND v.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN public.nocode_report_preference p ON p.dashboard_id=d.id AND p.user_id=#{actor} AND p.deleted=0 WHERE d.deleted=0 AND d.status='ACTIVE' AND d.published_version IS NOT NULL AND (d.owner_id=#{actor} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.nocode_report_resource_acl acl, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(acl.policy_json) member WHERE acl.resource_kind='DASHBOARD' AND acl.resource_id=d.id AND acl.deleted=0 AND (member->'actions') @> '["VIEW"]'::jsonb AND (member->>'principalKind') || ':' || (member->>'principalId') IN #{principal} )) AND (v.definition_json->>'name') ILIKE #{search} ESCAPE '!'
AND p.favorite=true AND p.last_visited_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.last_visited_at DESC,d.id DESC ORDER BY p.update_time DESC,d.id DESC ORDER BY d.update_time DESC,d.id DESC
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_report_preference WHERE user_id=#{actor} AND dashboard_id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_report_preference(user_id,dashboard_id,favorite,creator,updater) VALUES(#{actor},#{id},#{favorite},CAST(#{actor} AS text),CAST(#{actor} AS text)) ON CONFLICT(user_id,dashboard_id) DO UPDATE SET favorite=EXCLUDED.favorite,deleted=0, updater=EXCLUDED.updater, update_time=CASE WHEN nocode_report_preference.favorite IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.favorite OR nocode_report_preference.deleted!=0 THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE nocode_report_preference.update_time END

INSERT INTO public.nocode_report_preference(user_id,dashboard_id,last_visited_at,creator,updater) VALUES(#{actor},#{id},clock_timestamp(),CAST(#{actor} AS text),CAST(#{actor} AS text)) ON CONFLICT(user_id,dashboard_id) DO UPDATE SET last_visited_at=EXCLUDED.last_visited_at,deleted=0, updater=EXCLUDED.updater,update_time=clock_timestamp()
